scope: Development on all 48 phase-20/21 known plaintext passages. New test passages are not selected yet.
boundary_context: three letters to each side, spaces removed
selection_rule: Require zero newly introduced false cuts overall and at least one corrected fusion in each language; maximize corrected fusions, then higher threshold and lower weight. If none qualify, choose the fewest false cuts among settings improving both languages, then most corrected fusions; mark strict development failure. If none improve both, use weight=0, threshold=1 as identity fallback.
probability_warning: Smoothed training frequencies, not calibrated probabilities of correctness on another work.
key_policy: Phase-21 key search is unchanged; corrections only segment the fixed decoded letters.
